_README: Each entry exempts ONE violation_key for ONE predicate. Discipline (see ./README.md): every entry MUST carry a `dated` ISO date and a `justification` that cites the live pg_get_functiondef semantics proving the flag is NOT a real hole. NEVER allowlist a genuine escalation/leak — fix or report it. Re-verify entries when the function is next edited. Seeded 2026-06-10 from the first live validation run (project rhyzpcqhnizqbxphqdkr).

Verified live 2026-07-17 false positive from the predicate's documented column-name-only approximation. This trigger assigns Products.category to Foliar Fertilizer, Herbicide, or Other; products.category is unconstrained free text. The only enum-shaped category CHECK is customer_facts_category_check on a different table, so none of these Product assignments can violate that CHECK.

entries.violation_key: log_failed_notification(p_notification_type text, p_entity_type text, p_entity_id uuid, p_error_message text, p_payload jsonb, p_idempotency_key text)
entries.justification: Frontend/cron-called failed-notification logging helper (callers: Dashboard.tsx, notificationTriggers.ts). Insert-only into failed_notifications; no financial mutation, no privilege escalation, no PII read. Intentionally left ungated per 2026-06-09 round-3 disposition (a hard auth.uid() gate would break its cron/service_role callers). Verified live pg_get_functiondef 2026-06-10.

entries.violation_key: save_invoice(p_invoice jsonb, p_items jsonb, p_idempotency_key text)
entries.justification: Verified live 2026-07-20 as a transitive-gate false positive. The authenticated SECURITY DEFINER provenance wrapper's only pre-delegation DML is a transaction-local mutation claim; it delegates in the same transaction to `_save_invoice_split_provenance_impl_20260719`, which binds `auth.uid()`, requires an active admin or sales_rep, enforces customer and salesman scope for sales reps, and only then reaches the canonical writer. Any rejection aborts and rolls the claim back, and the private helper is not executable by Data API roles.

entries.violation_key: cancel_delivery(p_delivery_id uuid, p_cancel_reason text, p_performed_by uuid, p_idempotency_key text)
entries.justification: FALSE POSITIVE (non-canonical token): body DOES strict-actor-check (IF p_performed_by IS NOT NULL AND auth.uid() IS DISTINCT FROM p_performed_by THEN RAISE 'actor mismatch') and gates role on the auth.uid()-derived actor (admin/sales_rep, is_active). Flagged only because it raises 'actor mismatch' (with a space) instead of the canonical ACTOR_MISMATCH token. Verified live 2026-06-10. HARDENING: canonicalize the raised token to ACTOR_MISMATCH.

entries.violation_key: transfer_job_to_invoice(p_job_id uuid, p_performed_by uuid, p_idempotency_key text)
entries.justification: 2026-06-11: attribution-only p_performed_by (allocate_payment precedent). Live body (rewritten by 20260611002255 transfer_job_invoice_column_fixes, whose header explicitly dispositions this) authorizes via auth.uid() + role gate - corroborated by predicates (b) ungated-secdef-mutators and (d) auth-bound-role-ungated both clearing it on the live catalog 2026-06-11. p_performed_by only feeds COALESCE(p_performed_by, auth.uid()) attribution columns. Candidate for the standing defense-in-depth ACTOR_MISMATCH sweep, not an escalation.

Intentionally callable by any active authenticated field actor for that actor's own permanent offline receipt. Live body verified 2026-07-14: binds v_actor from auth.uid(), requires an active profile, row-locks the receipt, rejects actor_id mismatch with ACTOR_MISMATCH, binds the exact receipt idempotency key, and delegates only to complete_delivery/complete_job, whose canonical authorization remains authoritative. It cannot process another user's receipt or bypass the underlying business-role checks.
